title: The 1600-stream control-plane ceiling was measured on empty tables; ended-job lookups and the sweep's delete by created_at are unindexed (amend JS-030)
notes: D-050: also measure the WAL and vacuum cost of the heartbeat, lease, viewer-position and reaper tables (none is UNLOGGED), and rerun test/stress.sh with several helpers per heavy viewer (each helper reads the viewers every 500 ms since JS-167).
